subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Reciprocity: The Free Gift Trap
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Reciprocity: The Free Gift Trap.

hook.text: Someone gives you a free sample, a gift, or a compliment. Now you feel obligated to give back.

buildup.text: The reciprocity principle says humans feel compelled to return favors, even uninvited ones.

discovery.text: Con artists give small gifts to create a sense of debt that victims feel compelled to repay.

twist.text: The 'gift' costs the scammer pennies. The reciprocal payment costs the victim hundreds or thousands.

climax.text: Cults, timeshare sellers, and charity scammers all weaponize the reciprocity instinct.

punchline.text: Free gifts are investments in your guilt.

quiz.question: How do scammers exploit the reciprocity principle?
options: By giving small gifts to create a sense of obligation
By threatening consequences for not reciprocating
